messages.subject: Misaligned dotplot with dodging
parts:
Running the following code leads to the dotplot elements being centered for the "H" factor as expected, but leads to dotplot elements of the "L" factor to be slightly offset to the left.  

dat <- data.frame(letters=LETTERS[1:3], level = c("L","H"), size=rnorm(120))

ggplot(dat, aes(x=letters, y=size, fill = factor(level))) + 
  geom_boxplot(position=position_dodge(width=1)) +
  geom_dotplot(position=position_dodge(width=1), binaxis="y", stackdir="center", binwidth=.1, alpha = .3)


Am I missing a parameter to adjust to center or is this a minor bug?


dotplot is a great feature that works perfectly without dodging as the following shows

ggplot(dat, aes(x=letters, y=size)) + 
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_dotplot(binaxis="y", stackdir="center", binwidth=.1, alpha = .3)


Thanks for your help,

John
